title: Written voice
activation: make this sound less like a robot wrote it
rewrite the outage email so customers do not panic
this reads like marketing, make it plain
tighten this up, it is three pages saying one thing
draft the announcement in our voice
is the tone of this right
someone other than the author will read and act: a spec, proposal, status update, announcement, README, report, decision memo
write the announcement customers will read, draft the proposal with the decision at the top
unify documents written by different people into one voice
a draft reads buried, hedged, or salesy; surface the decision
standDown: not a deliverable: a chat reply, a code comment, a commit message, a quick answer
an external template dictates the format: a legal filing, a grant form, a journal structure
outcomes: prose in the house voice with the decision at the top
inputs: who will read it and what they must decide
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: a claim of done or tested that was not observed is removed, not softened
